page: Google Cloud Platform m4n-hypermem-64 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance belonging to the m4n server family. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, paired with 992.0 GB of system memory. This configuration yields a high memory-to-core ratio of 15.5 GB of RAM per vCPU, prioritizing memory capacity over compute density.

The instance does not include local storage or bundled GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. Additionally, the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses, requiring external networking configurations for public internet access.

Given the high density of memory relative to compute resources, this instance is designed for memory-intensive workloads. It is qualitatively positioned as a high-resource-density option for large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, and heavy data-caching layers where RAM capacity is the primary bottleneck.
